title: Operator feedback triage endpoints returned HTTP 400 instead of HTTP 401 on unauthenticated access
reproduction: Calling GET /v1/operator/feedback/reports or POST /v1/operator/feedback/reports/:reportId/status without an Authorization header resulted in a ValidationError mapping to HTTP 400 Bad Request instead of an AuthError mapping to HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
proposedRemediation: In assertOperator(request), throw AuthError('Authentication required') when request.actor is absent, ensuring uniform 401 challenge across all operator surfaces.

title: Workspace storage quota endpoint leaked unhandled PostgreSQL RLS 500 error on cross-tenant access
reproduction: User B requesting GET /v1/workspaces/:workspaceAId/files/quota caused quotaService to execute INSERT INTO app.workspace_storage_usage without prior membership assertion, triggering a PostgreSQL RLS violation and returning HTTP 500 instead of HTTP 404.
proposedRemediation: Check app.workspace_memberships inside withTenantContext before calling getStorageUsage, throwing NotFoundError('Workspace not found or access denied') to provide consistent IDOR non-existence proof.

title: Session revocation and token blacklisting verification across V2 endpoints
reproduction: Tokens from terminated sessions or revoked accounts could theoretically be honored until expiration (1h) if revocation checks were not evaluated on every request.
proposedRemediation: JwtVerifier queries app.revoked_tokens with SHA-256 token hash on every authenticated request, rejecting revoked tokens immediately with 401 TOKEN_REVOKED.

title: Malware quarantine and unverified file download fencing
reproduction: Files uploaded with suspect payload hashes or pending malware scanning must not be downloadable even by the workspace owner.
proposedRemediation: getFileDownloadCapability checks quarantine_status = 'verified'. Any other status (quarantined, pending) rejects download capability generation with FileNotReadyError (409 Conflict).

title: Assistant streaming and rich markdown output sanitization
reproduction: Assistant output could contain embedded HTML script tags, inline iframes, javascript: links, or remote 1x1 tracking pixels to phish or exfiltrate tokens.
proposedRemediation: sanitizeAssistantMarkdown strips raw HTML scripts, iframes, object/embed tags, javascript: pseudo-protocols, and remote tracking images while preserving valid markdown headings, bullet lists, bold text, and relative workspace links.

title: AI consent versioning, 0-day transient audio retention, and vault exclusion boundary
reproduction: Users without active AI consent or users targeting confidential vault notes could invoke transcription or AI proposals, risking data exposure or policy violation.
proposedRemediation: Enforce CURRENT_AI_CONSENT_VERSION before dispatching transcription, fail immediately with 403 on missing consent, reject vault targetKind unconditionally, and enforce 0-day transient audio buffer retention.

title: Diagnostic export and push notification telemetry leakage redaction
reproduction: Support diagnostic bundles or device push logs could accidentally capture private journal entries, auth tokens, or user email addresses.
proposedRemediation: Diagnostic exporter strictly redacts bearer tokens, email addresses, and personal note bodies to '[REDACTED]'; push adapter forces generic summaries for confidential and vault destinations.

title: Room membership revocation and Google Drive disconnection access fencing
reproduction: Revoked room members or foreign workspace callers might trigger Drive token exchange or disconnect commands on unauthorized workspaces.
proposedRemediation: Drive and room endpoints enforce tenant context, rejecting cross-workspace requests with 403 Forbidden; disconnectDrive executes idempotently without leaking tokens or remote resources.

title: Outstanding external independent cryptography review and physical Android ARM64 hardware verification
reproduction: Local software mocks and synthetic Vitest harnesses prove cryptographic protocol state machines, but cannot substitute for independent external third-party audit or hardware Keystore StrongBox validation.
proposedRemediation: Retain release gate DEF-V2-004 (vault independent review) and DEF-V2-008 (physical hardware verification). Mark Phase 97 blocked pending owner engagement of external security firm and physical device run.
